app.title: Gambit Rogue
app.tagline: A chess roguelite on irregular boards

menu.demoNotice: A run is 5 levels in a row: you start with 2 pieces and earn a reward after each win. Practice lets you replay each level with a fixed army.

levels.title: Practice

first-steps.name: First steps
first-steps.description: A pawn and a bishop wait on the sides. Learn to move your pieces and attack.

the-bend.name: The bend
the-bend.description: An L-shaped board: the enemies wait in the upper arm. Forests stop sliding pieces.

frozen-lake.name: Frozen lake
frozen-lake.description: A frozen lake in the middle of the map. Ice makes your pieces slide; water can only be jumped over.

the-pass.name: The pass
the-pass.description: Three enemies rush for the exits of your camp. Block their way for 6 rounds.

hold-the-line.name: Hold the line
hold-the-line.description: Four enemies rush your hero, and reinforcements burst in on the flanks. Hold for 5 rounds.

the-warden.name: The warden
the-warden.description: Take down the warden rook (5 HP) before the end of round 12.

levels.subtitle: Replay each level with a fixed army, as often as you like.

goal.eliminateLimited: Capture every enemy piece within {{rounds}} rounds
goal.intercept: Stop the enemies from reaching an exit for {{rounds}} rounds

game.selectPiece: Tap one of your pieces, or an enemy to see its reach.
game.chooseTarget: Tap a highlighted square (an attack's result is shown on its target), or another piece.
game.chooseLanding: The target survives: choose where to land.
game.noMoves: None of your pieces can act.
game.demoComplete: You finished the demo. Well done!
game.cornered: Cornered, the enemies go on the attack!
game.promotionRule: a pawn with Promotion that reaches it becomes a queen.
game.momentum: Momentum: your {{piece}} moves again! Act with it, or end the turn.
game.reinforcementsRule: enemies will arrive on this square on the round shown (if it is free).
game.enemyPromotionRule: an enemy pawn reaching it becomes a queen.
game.inspectHint: Hatched squares: what this enemy piece can attack next move.
game.threatRule: an enemy can attack there next move (“Enemy threats” button or tapped enemy).
game.exitRule: if an enemy reaches it, you lose. Block its path or stand on it.

reason.survived: You held out to the end.

ice.name: Ice
ice.rule: A piece that stops on it keeps sliding.

classes.title: Choose your hero
classes.subtitle: Your hero leads the army: if it falls, the run is lost.

sovereign.name: Sovereign
sovereign.description: A king and his rook. Whoever strikes the king faces his riposte.

knightess.name: Knight-errant
knightess.description: A mobile, sturdy knight protected by her shield, backed by a bishop.

forester.name: Woodland stride
forester.description: Forests no longer stop its slides.

reach.name: Reach
reach.description: King: up to 3 squares. Pawn: two more squares forward.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: The first attack taken each level deals no damage.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.description: If it survives an attack and can reach the attacker, it strikes back at once, even at range.

promotion.name: Promotion
promotion.description: A pawn reaching the far edge becomes a queen for the rest of the run. Every pawn is born with this power.

piercing.name: Piercing
piercing.description: Its slides pass through the first allied piece in the way.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.description: After a capture, it moves again at once (once per turn).

sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.description: Its attacks also hit enemies around the target (half damage).

knockback.name: Knockback
knockback.description: A surviving target is pushed back one square; against an obstacle, it takes 1 damage.

lifesteal.name: Lifesteal
lifesteal.description: Regains as much HP as the damage it deals.

run.deployHint: Tap one of your pieces to move it within the blue zone.
run.deployMove: Tap a zone square, or another of your pieces to swap them.
run.wonText: You made it through all {{total}} levels. Well done!
run.promotionHint: The purple edge marks your pawns’ promotion line.
run.reinforcementsHint: Enemy reinforcements will arrive on the red dashed squares.
